entities.summary: Ilya Andreyevich Mikheyev is a Russian professional ice hockey player who is a forward for the Chicago Blackhawks of the National Hockey League (NHL). He has previously played with the Toronto Maple Leafs and Vancouver Canucks of the NHL and Avangard Omsk of the Kontinental Hockey League.
